title: Colour audit and consolidation: find every colour written outside Color.java, move them into Color, and enforce it with a checkstyle check
description:
The standing rule is that colours are named constants in ixdar.graphics.render.color.Color, but nothing enforces it and colours keep being written inline. A rough grep on 2026-10-11 (ixdar-app/src/main) finds, outside Color.java: 26 hex literals (0xRRGGBB packed ints) in 5 files (PatchColors, MscCellAssembly, MeshMergeByDistance, HalfEdgeMeshRuntime, RingTool: e.g. RingTool.MARKED_RING_COLOR = 0xFF1A1A and the RING_COLORS palette), 26 `new ColorRGB(...)` calls in 12 files (ColorLerp, PatchColorHash, MeshOverlayRuntime, SDFUnion, ColorCommand, Drawing, MenuBox, DropDown, RoutePlanningTool, GLSLExpressionParser, MainScene, RegionColouring), a handful of literal vec3/vec4 colours in resources/glsl, and #RRGGBB in three SVGs under resources/res. There are also several colour representations side by side: Color/ColorRGB objects, packed RGB ints (Color.toPackedRgb, added by CRAW-63), Vector4f from toVector4f(), and per-palette int arrays. Consequences already seen: the CRAW-63 geodesic preview red collides with MARKED_RING_COLOR's red, a lavender ring colour was indistinguishable from the crease preview purple, and VIEW-20's toast fade reinvented ColorLerp.

Wanted: (1) a deterministic audit — not a one-off grep — that lists every place a colour value is written outside Color.java: hex int literals used as colours, `new ColorRGB(` / `new Color...(` with literal channels, Vector4f/float[] literals used as colours, packed-int palettes, GLSL literal colours, and resource colours; classified by kind (single named colour, palette, derived/lerped, alpha variant, shader, asset) with file:line; (2) a consolidation plan and its execution: each colour becomes a named Color constant (or a named palette in Color / one palette owner), duplicates and near-duplicates merged, one packed/Vector4f conversion path kept, call sites switched; (3) enforcement so it stays fixed: a custom checkstyle check in autofix (next to SingleCallerHelperCheck etc.), with an OpenRewrite recipe if a mechanical rewrite is possible, that fails on colour literals outside Color.java with a documented, narrow allowance (e.g. Color.java itself, generated palettes like PatchColorHash's hashing, test fixtures).
definition-of-done:
1. An audit that is reproducible by a command (tools/colour_audit.py, backed by the checkstyle check run with no allowance), listing every colour literal outside Color.java and every packed-RGB colour anywhere, with file:line and kind, attached to the ticket with counts before and after.
2. Every single colour in main source is a named constant in Color, named as a colour (CSS/X11 name where one is close), never by its use; the one exception is IXDAR, the logo red. Role names live at the use site as aliases (RingTool.MARKED_RING_COLOR = Color.HOT_PINK) only where they help. Constants that are the same colour are merged.
3. Color's constants are ordered by hue: neutrals black to white, then hue angle from red, ties by lightness, alpha variants (BASE_<percent>) after their base. A unit test (ColorOrderTest) pins the order, the alpha-variant naming, colour-word names and no duplicate colours.
4. Palettes are ixdar.graphics.render.color.Palette objects (ordered Colors with wrap-around indexing, size, minimum pairwise distance and the overflow shade RegionColouring uses), and the palettes Ixdar defines (ring, region, overlay group, patch, edge mark, GLSL vector components) are named constants of the final class Palettes. No Color[] palettes or palette methods on Color or at call sites.
5. No packed RGB anywhere in the repo: no toPackedRgb/fromPackedRgb, no 0xRRGGBB colour ints, no int arrays of colours, no shift/mask channel packing of colours. GPU and overlay uploads take Color (MeshOverlayRuntime.setLineGroups/setAnchorDiscs/setLabels take Color[]). Hex strings only where a file format requires them (none does: the patch JSON writes [r, g, b]).
6. Colours with clashing meanings are separated: MARKED_RING_COLOR vs the geodesic preview red, ring palette vs crease preview purple; the ticket records the chosen values.
7. A custom checkstyle check in autofix (ColorLiteralCheck) fails the build on new colour literals outside Color.java and on packed-RGB colours anywhere (hex ints in colour contexts, channel shifts landing in colour contexts, int/long declarations named ...Color/...Rgb), with the narrow allowance documented in the check; autofix artifact reinstalled and the Ixdar build green with it.
8. GLSL and SVG colours: each listed in the audit with a decision (named uniform fed from Color, or left as an asset colour with a reason).
9. Scenes look the same except where DoD 6 changes a colour on purpose: before/after screenshots of the ring scene, region tool, main scene and a menu.
testing-plan: 1. Run the audit command before and after; counts on the ticket. 2. mvn verify with the new check on. 3. A test file with a 0xRRGGBB colour and a new ColorRGB(1,0,0) fails the check; Color.java and the documented allowances pass. 4. Screenshot comparison of the scenes in DoD 7.
unknowns: How does the check tell a colour hex literal from other hex (bit masks, hashes, magic numbers)? By type context (ColorRGB/Color/Vector4f arguments, fields named *COLOR*/*COLOUR*, int arrays fed to colour setters) rather than by pattern alone.
Packed RGB ints (Color.toPackedRgb) exist for GPU upload paths: keep as a conversion on Color, or store palettes as packed ints in Color?
Are PatchColorHash / RegionColouring's generated colours in scope for named constants, or allowed as a documented generator?
changes-made: Audit command: uv run python tools/colour_audit.py [--autofix-classes ~/Code/autofix/target/classes] (Ixdar repo; tmp/ is gitignored so the script lives in tools/). Java hits come from autofix ColorLiteralCheck run with no allowance (same logic the build enforces); GLSL, Java-embedded FragColor shaders, SVG and DSL colours are scanned by the script. Kinds: single colour, palette, alpha variant, derived, shader, asset. BEFORE (master): total 89 = single colour 17, palette 28, alpha variant 5, derived 19, shader 5, asset 15. AFTER: total 21 = derived 1 (PatchColorHash, the documented generator in the color package), shader 5, asset 15; zero Java colour literals outside Color.java.

Consolidated into ixdar.graphics.render.color.Color: palettes RING_PALETTE (was RingTool.RING_COLORS int[]), REGION_PALETTE (was RegionColouring.PALETTE), OVERLAY_GROUP_PALETTE (was MeshOverlayRuntime.GROUP_PALETTE), PATCH_PALETTE (was SemanticPatchDecomposer hex String[]); single colours SIGNAL_GREEN/BLUE/YELLOW/ORANGE/TEAL/TAN/CREAM/LIME, HOT_PINK, ANCHOR_CYAN, CYAN_HALF, RED_HALF, MAGENTA_HALF, YELLOW_HALF, WHITE_QUARTER, ROUTE_EDGE_REMOVE/ADD, ROUTE_CROSSING, ROUTE_BUTTON(_SELECTED/_HOVER), MODEL_SOLID, REGION_UNSELECTED. Merged duplicates: ERROR_TOAST=SOFT_RED, CONNECTION_PATH=SIGNAL_YELLOW, CONNECTION_NECK=SIGNAL_GREEN (exact); near-duplicates within 10/255 per channel: FEATURE_EDGE_PRINCIPAL and the selected anchor -> SIGNAL_YELLOW, EDGE_MARK_AMBER -> SIGNAL_ORANGE, GLSL_FLOAT -> PINK, GLSL_VECTOR_FLOAT_Z -> GLSL_COMMA, DARK_PURPLE (a grey, 32,35,36) removed for DARK_GRAY.

One conversion path per representation on Color: toVector4f/toVector3f, toPackedRgb + fromPackedRgb, toHexRgb (patch JSON), fromVector4f, fromHsl (replaces the hand-written HSL in PatchColors and HalfEdgeMeshRuntime), fullHue (replaces getHSBColor(h,1,1)), random, withAlpha (replaces new ColorRGB(color, alpha)), shaded (RegionColouring's extra rounds). Removed channel arithmetic at call sites: MeshOverlayRuntime.colorOf, PatchColors.hslToRgb/channel, HalfEdgeMeshRuntime.hslToRgb, MscCellAssembly's own %06X formatting. RingTool keeps role aliases typed Color (MARKED_RING_COLOR, *_ANCHOR_COLOR) and converts with toPackedRgb() at the two use sites; ConnectionTool likewise.

Clash fixes: MARKED_RING_COLOR 0xFF1A1A -> Color.HOT_PINK 0xFF40A0 (RGB distance 0.68 from the geodesic red 0xFF0000, 0.47 from crease BRIGHT_PURPLE 0xB840FF, >=0.48 from every ring palette entry); the region summary log now says 'rings in pink'. GEODESIC_DRAFT_COLOR stays Color.RED, CREASE_DRAFT_COLOR stays BRIGHT_PURPLE. Ring palette vs crease purple: nearest entry is SIGNAL_BLUE at 0.65, no lavender left. test/unit/mesh/RingColoursTest pins both (min distance RegionColouring.MINIMUM_PALETTE_DISTANCE 0.45).

GLSL/SVG/DSL decisions: mesh_scalar.fs rampColor's four stops (lines 21-24) kept as a shader colormap: a continuous ramp only that shader interpolates, no Java role reads or draws them. mesh_uv_traces.fs patchColor is the generator PatchColorHash mirrors (saturation 0.55, value 0.85), kept. WebLauncher.drawFallbackTriangle's gl_FragColor is a WebGL smoke-test shader whose green varies by index, kept. SVGs res/decal.svg (#960024 = Color.IXDAR, #505050, #ffffff) and res/ratchet_menu*.svg (#28ad92, #f9f7b9, #505050, #ffffff) are source art for the PNG/SDF textures and are not loaded at runtime: asset colours. dsl/cube_boolean_textured.dsl color=<...> are model data: asset colours.

Generators: PatchColorHash stays a documented generator in the color package (the check allows computed construction there); PatchColors (golden-ratio hue per patch id) and HalfEdgeMeshRuntime.stableTagColor stay generators but now go through Color.fromHsl, so neither does channel arithmetic; RegionColouring's overflow shades go through Color.shaded; MainScene/ColorCommand hue gradients use Color.fullHue and random colours Color.random. Ids are unbounded, so named constants cannot replace them.

Verification (resumed agent): mvn test in the worktree 484 tests, 0 failures (BUILD SUCCESS against the installed autofix-tool, which does not yet carry the new check). autofix: ColorLiteralCheckTest 9/9, full autofix suite 30/30. New check run without installing, the way hooks/checkstyle_edit.py runs checkstyle (java -cp autofix/target/classes:<hook classpath minus autofix-tool jar> com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.Main -c autofix/target/classes/checkstyle.xml ixdar-app/src/main/java): ix-25 passes with 0 violations (tmp/colour/check-ix25-pass.txt); a scratch copy of RingTool outside the repo with MARKED_RING_COLOR = 0xFF1A1A and new ColorRGB(1f, 0f, 0f) fails with two [ColorLiteral] errors, lines 84 and 85 (tmp/colour/check-scratch-fail.txt). Audit rerun: total 21 = asset 15, derived 1, shader 5. Screenshots tmp/colour/{before,after}-{ring,regions,menu,main}.png, before from the main checkout's master build, after from this worktree, crawfish copy tmp/colour/crawfish_rings.dsl: ring scene 1 pixel differs (render noise), region tool (G) identical, menu 835 pixels differ in the animated fluid background while two master runs differ by 1620 (noise), main scene city layout is random per run but its colours (background 38,38,38, edge 98,142,166, city 0,255,255, labels white) are identical. The deliberate HOT_PINK marked-ring change is not visible in these shots because the crawfish fixture has no ring that splits nothing (region log: 'rings in pink: 0 split nothing' after vs 'rings in red: 0' before); RingColoursTest pins the chosen values. Launch entry 'IX-25: ring-tool' on the crawfish copy. Left for the user: install autofix (cd ~/Code/autofix && mvn -q install) and rebuild Ixdar with it (DoD 5).

Rework after review (2026-10-16), part 1, no packed RGB: removed Color.toPackedRgb/fromPackedRgb/toHexRgb, HEX_RGB_FORMAT, CHANNEL_BITS/CHANNEL_MAX. APIs changed from int to Color: MeshOverlayRuntime.setLineGroups(LineSet, int[], Color[]), setAnchorDiscs(int[], Color[], float[]), setLabels(float[], String[], Color[], float[]); fields MeshOverlayRuntime.labelColorRgb -> Color[] labelColors, lineGroupColorRgb -> Color[] lineGroupColors, RingTool.drawnRingColorRgb -> Color[] drawnRingColors; RingTool and ConnectionTool build Color[] group/anchor/disc colours; Patch.color String -> Color; PatchColors.uniquePatchColorHex removed. Hex strings: removed, since no file format requires one; the patch JSON (PatchDecomposerCLI.decompositionToJson, which the /mesh/patches/decompose route now reuses instead of a copy) writes color and flat_color as [r, g, b] in [0, 1]; ui-state's drawn ring rows report color by name instead of colorRgb. PixelImage.argb renamed pixels (a glReadPixels raster, image data not a colour). Left alone on purpose: HalfEdgeMeshRuntime's face-pick id code spread over the pick buffer's RGB (an id, not a colour) and RegionHidingTest's decode of it.

Rework part 2, palettes: new ixdar.graphics.render.color.Palette (final Color[] colors; size(); color(i) wraps with floorMod; shadedColor(i) darkens by OVERFLOW_SHADE 0.55 per completed round, RegionColouring's overflow; minimumDistance(); uses new Color.distanceTo) and final class Palettes: RING, REGION, OVERLAY_GROUP, PATCH, EDGE_MARK (was MeshNodeViewerScene.EDGE_MARK_COLORS), GLSL_VECTOR_COMPONENT (was GLSLParseText.VECTOR_COMPONENT_COLORS). Removed Color.RING_PALETTE/REGION_PALETTE/OVERLAY_GROUP_PALETTE/PATCH_PALETTE, RegionColouring.paletteColor and EXTRA_ROUND_SHADE, MeshOverlayRuntime.paletteColor.

old GOLD was 255,217,26), GLSL_SKIP->LEMON_CHIFFON, SIGNAL_CREAM->PALE_GOLDENROD, YELLOW_HALF->YELLOW_50, GLSL_EQUALS->KEY_LIME, SIGNAL_LIME->GREEN_YELLOW, GLSL_FUNCTION->CELADON, GLSL_BOOLEAN->PALE_GREEN, REGION_MINT->PASTEL_GREEN, GLSL_VECTOR_FLOAT_Y->TEA_GREEN, ROUTE_EDGE_ADD->NEON_GREEN_80, SIGNAL_GREEN and CONNECTION_NECK->MALACHITE, BRIGHT_GREEN->SCREAMIN_GREEN, REGION_SPRING_GREEN->SPRING_GREEN, COMMAND->JADE, SIGNAL_TEAL->TURQUOISE, CYAN_HALF->CYAN_50, REGION_AQUA->ELECTRIC_BLUE, ANCHOR_CYAN->BRIGHT_CYAN, SKY_BLUE->VIVID_SKY_BLUE, EDGE_MARK_CYAN->DEEP_SKY_BLUE, GLSL_TYPE->LIGHT_BLUE, NAVY->OXFORD_BLUE, BLUE_WHITE->CADET_BLUE, GLSL_BRACE->ALICE_BLUE, SIGNAL_BLUE->DODGER_BLUE, MODEL_SOLID->PALE_CORNFLOWER_BLUE, REGION_COBALT->DENIM, GLSL_COMMA and GLSL_VECTOR_FLOAT_Z->PERIWINKLE, ROUTE_CROSSING->AZURE_80 (merged, 51,128,255 -> 64,128,255), GLSL_PARENTHESIS->LAVENDER, LIGHT_NAVY->MIDNIGHT_BLUE, BLUE_GRAY->SPACE_CADET, ROUTE_BUTTON_SELECTED->SLATE_BLUE_90, ROUTE_BUTTON_HOVER->DARK_BLUE_GRAY_90, REGION_VIOLET->ELECTRIC_VIOLET, GLSL_VECTOR->WISTERIA, GLSL_VECN->MAUVE, MAGENTA_HALF->MAGENTA_50, REGION_ORCHID->ULTRA_PINK, EDGE_MARK_MAGENTA->SHOCKING_PINK, REGION_ROSE->ROSE, GLSL_FLOAT->PINK, DARK_IXDAR->OXBLOOD; the 20 patch palette ints became PARADISE_PINK, APRICOT, DARK_SEA_GREEN, GUNMETAL, SALMON, OLD_LAVENDER, QUEEN_BLUE, MELON, PALE_VIOLET_RED, LIGHT_CORAL, OPERA_MAUVE, PEWTER_BLUE, MAGIC_MINT, MELLOW_APRICOT, TERRACOTTA, VISTA_BLUE, LAUREL_GREEN, LIGHT_PINK, ENGLISH_VIOLET, THISTLE. Kept: WHITE, BLACK, TRANSPARENT, RED, GREEN, BLUE, CYAN, YELLOW, MAGENTA, PINK, AMBER, AZURE, PURPLE, BRIGHT_PURPLE, LIGHT_PURPLE, HOT_PINK, and IXDAR (logo red, the one non-colour name, at its hue among the crimsons). Deleted as unused: RED_FAINT, FEATURE_EDGE_DIHEDRAL/CREST/SADDLE/CREST_HONORED. Role aliases at use sites: GLSLParseText.FLOAT/VECTOR/VECN/PARENTHESIS/BRACE/COMMA/KEYWORD/TYPE/FUNCTION/OPERATOR/EQUALS/BOOLEAN/SKIP_COLOR, ErrorToasts.REFUSAL_COLOR, RingTool and RoutePlanningTool's existing aliases. Ordering rule: r=g=b neutrals first by lightness, then hue angle from 0 (red), ties (within 0.001 deg) by HSL lightness, then the more opaque first; ColorOrderTest (test/unit/render) reads Color.java's declaration order and pins it, plus BASE_<percent> alpha names, colour-word names (IXDAR allowed by name) and no two constants with the same RGBA.

Rework part 4, check and verification: ColorLiteralCheck (autofix, uncommitted, not installed) now reports kind 'packed RGB' (message color.packed) in every file, Color.java included: hex ints in colour contexts, SL/SR/BSR shifts whose expression lands in a colour context (colour-named assignment, colour method or ColorRGB argument, return from a colour method), and int/long fields, variables, parameters and methods named ...Color(s)/...Colour(s)/...Rgb that are not layout names. ColorLiteralCheckTest 12/12 (3 new tests: packed RGB in Color.java, ints named as colours, pick id code and palette indices left alone), autofix suite 33/33. Run uninstalled with autofix/target/classes first on the classpath and the full build checkstyle.xml: ix-25 0 violations (tmp/colour/check-ix25-pass.txt); a scratch file with MARKED_RING_COLOR = 0xFF1A1A, int[] drawnRingColorRgb, an int[] groupColor parameter and r << 16 | g << 8 | b fails with four packed-RGB errors (tmp/colour/check-scratch-fail.txt). Audit with the extended check: BEFORE (master 61ac1100) total 111 = packed RGB 34, single colour 13, palette 20, alpha variant 5, derived 19, shader 5, asset 15; AFTER total 21 = derived 1 (PatchColorHash), shader 5, asset 15 (tmp/colour/audit-after-rework.txt). mvn test 485/485. Screenshots tmp/colour/rework-*.png vs the master before-*.png: ring 1 pixel (noise), region tool identical, menu 2037 pixels under default fuzz, 0 at fuzz 40, while two runs of this build differ by 3129 (animated fluid noise), main scene dominant colours identical (38,38,38 background, 98,142,166 edges, 0,255,255 cities, white labels). Still for the user: install autofix (cd ~/Code/autofix && mvn -q install) and rebuild Ixdar with it.

wt done (2026-10-16) refused before building: its sync runs git add -A -- . ':(exclude)tmp', which git now rejects because master 61ac1100 added tmp/ to .gitignore (ai-workspace ixd/worktree.py TMP_EXCLUDE, lines 30/240/1070). Not an IX-25 failure; the work was synced to 61ac1100 just before, mvn test 485/485 there, and ixdar-cli launch 'IX-25: ring-tool' runs ok headless. Ticket left in REVIEW.

Rename round (2026-10-16, after the user's ruling 'every color needs a normal name ... color name first then any descriptor'): every Color constant is BASE[_LEAN][_LIGHTNESS][_ALPHA] with BASE/LEAN from BLACK GREY WHITE RED ORANGE BROWN YELLOW GREEN TEAL BLUE PURPLE PINK and LIGHTNESS from DARK VERY_DARK LIGHT VERY_LIGHT PASTEL (e.g. SPACE_CADET -> BLUE_VERY_DARK, PERIWINKLE -> PURPLE_PASTEL, CORAL_RED -> RED_LIGHT, CYAN -> TEAL, MAGENTA -> PURPLE_PINK); IXDAR, DARK_IXDAR (restored from OXBLOOD) and TRANSPARENT keep their names. Merges of near-identical colours: LIGHT_CORAL into SALMON (RED_VERY_LIGHT), DARK_ORANGE into ORANGE, GOLD into AMBER (YELLOW_ORANGE), DARK_SEA_GREEN into LAUREL_GREEN (GREEN_GREY_LIGHT). ColorOrderTest now checks names start with a BASE word and use only BASE, lightness words and an _<percent> suffix. Full table in the worktree's tmp/colour/rename.md. mvn test 485/485.
